newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber plans share offerings.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber plans share offerings.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchance Commission relating to a proposed secondary public offering of 6,834,066 shares of common stock.

It also filed an SEC statement for a proposed primary offering of 4,500,000 depositary shares, each representing an interest in a share of automatically convertible equity securities (ACES). The offering price per share will be based on the trading price of the common stock at the time of the offering.

Brooks said the secondary offering of 6,834,066 shares represents about 31 percent of the company's total outstanding restricted shares. Of the total shares in the proposed offering, 215,843 are being sold by management and employee shareholders.
The proceeds from the ACES will be used to fund development and expansion to 40 markets by the end of 1997 from the company's current 30 markets.
